workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-389g-gv7q-r4x8] fastify is vulnerable to header validation bypass via case-sensitive propertyNames (Affects fastify < 5.12.6)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade fastify to patched release >= 5.12.6: npm install 'fastify@>=5.12.6' (Advisory: GHSA-389g-gv7q-r4x8)
